positive_expectations: For integer i32/u32 instances, clamp panics in debug-assertions mode exactly when min>max. Otherwise return min if input<min; else max if input>max; else input. Preserve this branch order for reversed bounds when assertions are disabled.
clamp_min returns min iff input<min; clamp_max returns max iff input>max. Their reflexivity assertions succeed for selected integer types.
Exhaust all triples over i32 -8..8 and u32 0..16, all pairs over i32 -128..127 and u32 0..255, and all triples/pairs of seven full-width edge values per type. Equal/reversed bounds are included.
Assertions, comparison order, scalar cleanup, and exact result transport must compose through original Cargo capture, verification, strict admission and matching before support is claimed.
negative_expectations: Custom/effectful PartialOrd and nonreflexive PartialEq/PartialOrd remain unsupported; oracle controls demonstrate that substituting pure primitive comparison semantics changes behavior.

Custom effectful controls observe every comparison, including debug-only checks, in original order. Nonreflexive controls panic for all three functions with debug assertions and return input when disabled.

Wrong/missing concrete substitutions, primitive trait/implementation authority, selected definition/source/build association, stale invocation, changed body/macro, or wrong debug mode must reject or remain incomplete.

Signed/unsigned instances and feature/assertion contexts never share substituted evidence merely because function names or source are equal. Floats, custom ADTs, Drop-bearing types and arbitrary generic traits remain out of scope.
bounded_contract: Exact selected free-function bodies instantiated only at i32/u32 under pinned Cargo/compiler contexts. Independently prove core primitive PartialOrd/PartialEq operations and complete generic source-to-instance correspondence; no universal generic-function purity or arbitrary trait support.
known_blockers: Generic instance capture/identity/substitutions and linking, replay and source/interface correspondence. Current source contract permits only lifetime parameters.
Generic operators use trait-dependent HIR dispatch; exact primitive PartialOrd/PartialEq implementation/operation evidence is required before integer builtin lowering.
Whole root-module imports, macro definitions/invocations and shadowing closure; existing scalar leaf proof is float-specific/nongeneric and does not cover this family.
Original clamp_min/clamp_max carry #[allow(clippy::eq_op)] in addition to #[inline]; preserve exact attrs and existing lint-only attribute semantics.

All bodies contain debug_assert!(condition,literal_message); use registered assertion authority/diagnostic/source/build checks, including inactive debug bodies, rather than deleting macros or treating their operands as pure.
unknowns: Actual instance/trait-selection identities and Cargo dependency association await capture.
Additional precise root-module/source-boundary blockers await full original capture and evidence audit; unsupported/incomplete/inactive remain distinct.
acceptance: Native independent oracle plus complete original instance Cargo capture, verification, strict admission, matching, adversarial evidence controls and unchanged frozen admission delta; no activation or detector-quality claim.
